scripts.db:up: docker compose -f deploy/local/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis
scripts.db:setup: pnpm --filter @fabweb/api db:generate && pnpm --filter @fabweb/api db:migrate && pnpm --filter @fabweb/api db:seed
scripts.start: pnpm --filter @fabweb/shared build && pnpm --filter @fabweb/costing build && pnpm -r --parallel dev
